zh.content: 你的三号位在对线期CS达到了60.75，但p75高达84，说明顶尖玩家会在对线期就疯狂压制补刀。如果你玩三号位，前10分钟必须把补刀作为首要目标，争取达到60以上，同时利用英雄强势期（如Beastmaster的豪猪）耗血并控线。
四号位平均死亡6.75次，五号位6.25次，远超其他位置。你必须大幅减少死亡——每死一次等于送对面400+金币和经验。关键：对线期不要站桩换血，多用技能远程消耗；中期永远和核心保持一个屏幕距离，绝不独走。出一个保命装（如微光披风或推推棒）至关重要。
三号位击杀参与率高达76.1%，而一号位只有64.2%。这说明三号位在中期打架更积极。如果你打一号位，一定要提高支援意识：一旦推完线，就TP参与最近的团战，不要只顾farm。三号位则要继续保持凶狠的参战节奏。
一号位平均GPM 825，极高，但平均死亡3.5次也不低。你的farm效率已经不错，但要注意别在死的时候送掉积累的优势。调整：如果前期死两次，立即转保守farm，只在安全线打钱，不探危险区域。
二号位平均插了1.75个眼，而一号位和四号位是0。作为中单，你应该自己买真假眼来控符和防Gank，尤其是在夜晚前在河道插眼。这个数据表明顶级中单会自费眼位，你也要养成这个习惯。
Beastmaster在510秒就做出支配头盔，892秒升级统御头盔，1091秒拿到跳刀。你玩这个英雄时，必须严格卡这些时间点：9分钟前统御头盔，18分钟前跳刀+BKB。如果慢了，说明你的打钱节奏或游走效率不足。
Gyrocopter在640秒小水晶，1025秒A杖，1274秒大炮。你玩飞机时，应该以这些为目标：10分钟小水晶+草鞋，17分钟A杖，22分钟大炮+BKB。如果拖到25分钟才出大炮，你的中期强势期就浪费了。
四号位平均插眼9.75个，五号位12.5个，差距不大。但四号位死亡6.75次，说明你的插眼还不够安全。你应该用技能或跳刀探视野后再插高台眼，避免插眼时被抓。同时四号位也要优先出跳刀（如Snapfire 580秒跳刀）来创造进攻视野。

虚空假面打野速度慢，不要轻易弃线打野。如果对线艰难，应该利用大招参与击杀或轮换到其他路，而不是去打野。
对线时尽量拉野，特别是当你在线上时，拉野可以帮你控制兵线并获得额外经验。在4分20秒左右可以利用拉野将兵线推向对方塔下。
团战中明确自己是反先手角色。这局中你的任务是保护狙击手，注意对方突进目标，站在潮汐身后作为反打点。
不要盲目冲浪（追着兵线跑）。13分钟时你冲了一波兵线是个大错误，导致错过团战。只有当附近没有兵线时才考虑走远。
装备优先级：这局推荐先出黑皇杖（BKB）而不是幻影斧，因为你需要BKB来安全放大招。
对线时一定要做好兵线封锁，避免小兵位置不佳。这个版本的祈求者非常依赖对线优势，错误的兵线封锁会让你被远程消耗并丢失补刀。
对线赏金猎人这种近战中单时，持续压制其血量，逼他购买大量回复装备，浪费其经济。这样即使补刀持平，你的净经济也领先。
合理使用天火补远程兵、收人头或配合队友。不要随意用天火耗蓝，只在能补刀或击杀时使用。
养成用陨石推线的习惯，利用其高伤害快速清兵，然后去刷野或看边路天火机会。
点金手祈求者要打得贪婪：线上刷钱、用天火收人头，不要频繁游走。你的任务是快速刷出点金手和A杖，而不是支援边路。
面对混沌骑士这种高爆发抓人阵容，早点出跳刀比出希瓦更有用。跳刀提供位置调整，避免被先手秒杀。
团战技能交完后如果无法打赢，立刻传送去分推带线，给对手兵线压力，迫使他们撤退。有机器人后分推效率更高。

en.content: Your offlaner averages 60.75 CS at 10 minutes, but the 75th percentile is 84—meaning top players dominate the lane. If you play position 3, prioritize last-hitting to hit at least 60 CS by 10 minutes, and use your hero's strength (like Beastmaster's boar) to harass and control the wave.

Position 4 and 5 average 6.75 and 6.25 deaths respectively—far too high. You must cut deaths: in lane, trade with spells from max range, never stand still; mid-game, always stay within a screen of your core, never wander alone. A defensive item (Glimmer Cape or Force Staff) is mandatory.

Position 3 has 76.1% kill participation vs 64.2% for position 1. As a carry, you must increase map awareness: after pushing the wave, TP to the nearest fight instead of farming only. As an offlaner, keep this aggressive fight participation up.

Carry GPM averages 825—very good, but 3.5 deaths is still high. Your farming is efficient, but dying throws away the lead. Adjust: if you die twice in early-mid game, switch to conservative farming, only taking safe waves and avoiding dangerous areas.

Position 2 places 1.75 obs on average, while pos1 and pos3 place 0. As a midlaner, you should buy observer and sentry wards to control runes and avoid ganks—especially place a river ward before night. This habit separates pro mids from amateurs.

Beastmaster gets Helm of the Dominator at 5:10, upgrades to Overlord at 8:52, and Blink at 10:51. When playing BM, you must hit these timings: Overlord by 9 min, Blink+BKB by 18 min. If you're slower, improve your farming patterns or ganking efficiency.

Gyrocopter gets Blight Stone (Lesser Crit) at 6:40, Aghs at 10:25, Daedalus at 12:74. As Gyro, aim for: Blight stone+Brown boots by 10 min, Aghs by 17 min, Daedalus+BKB by 22 min. Delaying Daedalus past 25 min wastes your mid-game power spike.

Pos4 places 9.75 obs vs pos5's 12.5—close. But pos4 dies 6.75 times, meaning ward placement is unsafe. Use spells or Blink (Snapfire gets Blink at 5:80!) to scout before warding cliffs. Also, pos4 should prioritize Blink to create offensive vision.

In pro matches, Position 1 (Carry) averages 65 last hits at 10 minutes (top 25% reach 71), 826 GPM overall, and 3.5 deaths per game (sample: 4 player-games). Average kill participation is 64%. If your CS at 10 is below 52, something usually went wrong in the laning stage (pressured out, over-roaming, or missed last hits); with more than 6 deaths, review why you died (vision, positioning, greedy lane pushes) before blaming mechanics.

In pro matches, Position 2 (Mid) averages 56 last hits at 10 minutes (top 25% reach 69), 624 GPM overall, and 2.8 deaths per game (sample: 4 player-games). Average kill participation is 64%. If your CS at 10 is below 45, something usually went wrong in the laning stage (pressured out, over-roaming, or missed last hits); with more than 5 deaths, review why you died (vision, positioning, greedy lane pushes) before blaming mechanics.

In pro matches, Position 3 (Offlaner) averages 61 last hits at 10 minutes (top 25% reach 84), 582 GPM overall, and 3.0 deaths per game (sample: 4 player-games). Average kill participation is 76%. If your CS at 10 is below 48, something usually went wrong in the laning stage (pressured out, over-roaming, or missed last hits); with more than 5 deaths, review why you died (vision, positioning, greedy lane pushes) before blaming mechanics.

In pro matches, Position 4 (Support) places 9.8 observer wards and dies 6.8 times per game (sample: 4 player-games). Average kill participation is 61%. Fewer than 5 observer wards means you are under-investing in vision; kill participation below 46% means you are not rotating or joining fights enough; more than 9 deaths usually comes from warding/dewarding too deep without backup.

In pro matches, Position 5 (Hard Support) places 12.5 observer wards and dies 6.2 times per game (sample: 4 player-games). Average kill participation is 68%. Fewer than 7 observer wards means you are under-investing in vision; kill participation below 53% means you are not rotating or joining fights enough; more than 8 deaths usually comes from warding/dewarding too deep without backup.
